figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN name IS NULL OR TRIM(name)='' THEN '名称缺失' WHEN amount IS NULL THEN '金额缺失' WHEN CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2))<0 THEN '负金额待核' ELSE '通过' END AS quality FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
